features: DOES NOT TOUCH THE DATABASE — No migration, no new column or table, and the update rewrites no data. Emailing the settlement sheets uses the existing log of letters and receipts. No new permission; requirements are unchanged. After updating, reload any pages that are already open.

NEW: THE PROPOSED SETTLEMENT, PERSON BY PERSON — The financial statement has a «Conguaglio» (settlement) tab. For each person, unit by unit and item by item: their share of the year's expenses, split by days when a unit changed owner or tenant; the expenses for their unit alone not yet requested; the instalments of the plans; and the difference, the proposed settlement, to be approved by the assembly. Next to it, what is already due (instalments requested and unpaid, and other amounts outside the instalments) and the balance if the assembly approves. Expenses of extraordinary works without an accrual period written on the invoice go to whoever was the owner when the assembly approved the works, including those recorded in later years; with the period written, to whoever was the owner on those days. The settlement of the works is proposed in the year in which the works end (the end date of the management): until then the tab shows what was spent and what was requested. An expense recorded after the works ended is settled in the year it is recorded, with a warning. Where the program cannot split without choosing for you it does not calculate, and the tab says why and what to do: works with resolutions on different dates or without the resolution date (the whole management), or an item that two plans split with different periods when a unit of the item changed owner or tenant. An amount already paid for a unit that no plan used, after a change of owner, goes on nobody's sheet: the tab shows it, and you decide who it goes to.

NEW: THE SETTLEMENT PRINTS — The statement by table, the settlement by person and each person's sheet, in the style of the financial statement prints, with the office details, the logo or the letterhead chosen in the office papers. At the top the sheet says what is already due (or already in credit), the proposed settlement «only if the assembly approves» and the balance if the assembly approves, and it has a «Come leggere questo foglio» (How to read this sheet) box in plain words. Sheets can be downloaded one by one or together in a .zip archive, up to 200 at a time: beyond that, you choose the people of one page of the list.

NEW: THE SETTLEMENT SHEETS BY EMAIL — From the «Conguaglio» tab the sheets are sent by email, to everyone or to the people you choose, to the person's email and secondary email, and to the certified email (PEC) if you tick it (it goes out as a plain email from the mail server, not as PEC, and some PEC boxes reject it), with the PDF attached. Subject and text can be changed, also starting from an office template (among the letter templates there is the «Email del foglio del conguaglio» type). Fixed lines follow the text: it is a proposal to be approved by the assembly, not a payment request, and instalments already requested are still due as usual; the date and time the figures were calculated; and, if part of the sheet is not yet calculated, a line saying so. Next to each person there is the last sending, with the error in plain words if it did not go out, and «Rimanda i fogli non partiti» (Resend the sheets that did not go out) redoes them with today's figures. The sent PDF is kept and can be reopened from the tab. Without the queue service at most fifty messages go out at a time, by whole persons; with any queue, at most 200 sheets at a time.

NEW: FOUR SETTLEMENT CHECKS — In the «Controlli» tab and its print: «Il conguaglio divide le spese dell'esercizio», «Ogni unità ha la sua parte», «Le quote tornano con il riparto» and «Le spese personali tornano con le anticipazioni». The financial statement now has fourteen checks. Where a page or a print does not calculate the settlement (a very large condominium, or the booklet without the settlement part), the four checks say «non calcolato» (not calculated) and are not counted among those that match. Where a unit passes from one owner to another with uncovered days and no recorded transfer, the per-unit check says «da leggere» (to read) and links to the unit's owners («Apri i titolari dell'unità», Open the unit's owners), where the transfer is recorded.

NEW: THE FUND MOVEMENT — The balance sheet, on screen and in print, shows for each fund the opening balance, the amount set aside, the amount used, the transfers from one fund to another in two separate columns, when there is at least one, and the closing balance: a transfer between two funds counts neither as set aside nor as used.

NEW: THE SETTLEMENT IN THE SUMMARY AND IN THE ASSEMBLY BOOKLET — The summary has the condominium settlement box, with a link to the tab. The assembly booklet includes the settlement by person, has the booklet page number on every page, and a short checks box on the cover page; the check lines are at the end, under «Controlli interni, per chi vuole il dettaglio» (Internal checks, for those who want the detail). In the booklet window the «Mostra l'ultima lettera di sollecito» (Show the last reminder letter) box, off by default, decides whether the booklet's credits print has that column.

CHANGED: POSITIONS AND CREDITS OF THE BOOKLET IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT STYLE — The prints of the owners' positions and of the credits by age have the style of the other financial statement prints. Figures and rows are unchanged.

CHANGED: THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT TEXTS — A zero result says «in pareggio» (break-even), and has a single name on the page and in the prints. The summary's budget says it is net of third-party income. The balance sheet says «finito» (ended) like the summary; the lines reconciling cash and accrual are called what they are, variations. Texts that promised features «in arrivo» (coming) no longer do, and the settlement prints for owners (the person's sheet, the settlement by person and the statement by table) give no instructions to the administrator and do not talk about «the program».

CHANGED: OVERDUE INSTALMENTS — The filters have menus like the rest of the program; the person is chosen from the list of the condominium's people by typing part of the name; next to each filter an icon explains what it is for. «Seleziona tutte le N dei filtri» (Select all N of the filters) and «Togli la scelta» (Clear the selection) are buttons at the start of the row, and «Dispense dei sei mesi» (Six-month exemptions) is a button like the others. The «Guida» (Guide) button opens the page guide. An old address with a search by name shows «Solo i nomi con …» (Only names with …) with a button to remove it, and the print and the letters follow it.

CHANGED: SIX-MONTH EXEMPTIONS — The page explains what it is for, with three cards and the side guide, and has «Indietro» (Back) to the page you came from. The minutes number has an example and its explanation; the minutes are attached with «Scegli il file» (Choose the file); the people the exemption applies to are chosen from a menu with search.

CHANGED: THE FIELD FOR CHOOSING A FILE — In the exemptions, in the repayment agreement window and in the office letterhead, the file is chosen with the «Scegli il file» (Choose the file) button, with the name next to it and the × to remove it, all in Italian.

CHANGED: FINANCIAL STATEMENT TABS, LEDGER AND STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT — Each financial statement tab has three guide cards at the top. The tables under the accounting ledger and those of the check on entries outside the year's boundary sit in a box, like the movements table. In the person's statement of account «Prepara una lettera» (Prepare a letter) and «Rate scadute» (Overdue instalments) are in the «Lettere» (Letters) menu.

CHANGED: PAGES ON TABLETS AND SMALL LAPTOPS — Below 1,280 pixels wide the top bar shows the compact menu, with all the items, and the header buttons wrap when they do not fit: at 1,024 pixels and on tablets the bar and the header no longer make the page scroll sideways.

FIXED: EXPENSES FOR A SINGLE UNIT WITHOUT AN ITEM IN THE APPROVED BUDGET — In the accrual summary the expenses for a single unit requested with the instalments are on a row of their own, «spese personali chieste con le rate» (personal expenses requested with the instalments), and the approved budget of the summary and of the cover page includes them; those without an item were left out before.

FIXED: THE PRINT SETTINGS PAGE TEXTS — The letterhead form no longer says that in letters the recipient stays 112 mm from the edge for the window envelope, and the other texts of the page say what each choice does today.
